MountedGisMapProbeSourceV1.description: 🔬️ The mounted state a GIS map probe is taken from: the exact scope, activation identity, checkpoint frontier, content digests and guest-acknowledged UI revision it observed.

MountedGisMapProbeV1.description: 🗺️ The projection a mounted GIS map publishes. It repeats the acknowledged checkpoint, frontier and mounted identity exactly and reduces the map root to its region ids; the root kind is fixed by the artifact standard.

MountedArtifactFrontierV1.description: 🌿 The exact scope-bound checkpoint frontier acknowledged by one mounted browser actor.

CadPresenceRetirementLaws.title: CadPresenceRetirementLaws
CadPresenceRetirementLaws.description: 📐️ The presence-retirement laws of the CAD editor: the grant bound, the utility/step/pane retirement cases and the shared-store cases.

allOf.title: HomeRetainedCommandLimits
allOf.description: The `s.space.home@1/*#editor` app's retained-command execution law: its owned job factory, eight byte/step budgets, seventeen-route disposition census, and scalar boundary cases.

packSchemaHash.description: 🧬️ The codec's structural pack-schema fingerprint (`os_pack::schema_hash`), generated from the live Rust receipt by the gis `native-codec-projection` verb; the trusted-catalog bootstrap reads it verbatim.

GisNativeCodecs.title: GisNativeCodecs
GisNativeCodecs.description: 🌍️ The native-openable codec receipt projection GIS publishes to the hub: provider identity plus one receipt per artifact codec.

MutationOutcomeClass.description: 🎯️ The protocol outcome class a direct mutation can reach — the same vocabulary as the repository test protocol's `MutationOutcomeClass`, carried verbatim by bridges and manifests.

editable.description: Whether the history editor may edit this leaf's inputs. Absent or true: the leaf is editable and shows at least one input. False declares it withdraw-only (design §22.20): #[derive(MutationLeaf)] answers input_schema() == None, no gate judges its inputs, and its history row offers Withdraw only.

ApprovedMutationVerbV1.description: 🎨️ Closed imperative action ontology for concrete mutation semantics.

MutationVerbPairV1.description: 📗️ Exact imperative action and past-tense record ontology.

schema.title: Renderer
schema.description: Renderer-owned presentation contracts: shell dialog/effect origin admission, tutorial drive and playback, document opening and instance admission, host identity bootstrap, extension invocation, mounted probe projection, and the runtime/graph/helper element contracts. Renderer elements (🧱️elements/*) and rendering targets (🎯️targets/*) are consumers; this module is the sole owner.

ShellDialogOriginV1.description: 🗨️ The identity a modal dialog or shell effect was raised from. Two origins are the same origin only when every field is equal; a detached document or a reopened client instance is a different origin.

AdmittedShellInstanceTransitionV1.description: 🛂️ One admission attempt for a shell instance handed off across a create/retire boundary: a creation is admitted only when the instance is retained both before and after it.

DocumentOpeningTransitionV1.description: 🚪️ One document-opening attempt: where it was made to fail, where it was replaced, the observed step sequence and the settled outcome. No opening may leave a live timer behind.

DocumentOpeningAdmissionV1.description: 🛂️ Admission of one opening into the shell: a background opening never displaces the visible session, and every rejected admission closes exactly the sessions it names.

DocumentOpeningBackgroundSequenceV1.description: 🌒️ Ordered lifecycle steps a background document session goes through while the visible session stays mounted.

DocumentOpeningCloseFailureV1.description: 🧯️ A close that failed while an opening was in flight, and the step sequence it still had to complete.

DocumentOpeningTargetV1.description: 📍️ The exact scope a document reference resolves to. A hub target always carries the requested surface and is persistedShared; a folder target never invents one and is persistedLocalOnly.

SharedDocumentOpeningAccessV1.description: 👁️ One shared-document opening access decision: the signed-in human `userId` opens a document of `spaceId` whose directory events so far are `events`, and `role` is the surface role the shell requests — the editor only when the caller's member role permits `document.write` under the hub's declared access policy (the hub issues exactly that surface for that role and refuses any other), the viewer for a Spectator, a removed member or a non-member, null when the events hold no such space.

DocumentOpeningScopeResolutionV1.description: 🧭️ One document-opening scope resolution: a reference plus the shell context it is resolved in, settling either into exact targets or into a typed refusal. Never both.

DocumentFirstOpenV1.description: 🥇️ The first open of a document: it asks only for the surface it requested, walks the request stages in order, and opens exactly one socket.

sessionKept.description: Whether the worker still holds the hub session capability after the refused open: a cancelled or retired open is no evidence against the hub and keeps it; a hostile plan or asset revokes it.

TutorialRunTransitionV1.description: 🎥️ One tutorial run: the events it received, whether it started, and how many UI snapshots it restored (never more than one).

TutorialDriveTransitionV1.description: 🕹️ One tutorial drive: the claim/release events it observed and whether the drive was active after each of them.

PausedTutorialSeekTransitionV1.description: ⏩️ One seek against a paused tutorial: a seek applies exactly one mutation, lands on an exact playhead, and only resumes playback when it was playing and nothing interrupted it.

SerialTutorialDriveTransitionV1.description: 🧵️ One serialized tutorial drive write: the writes it emitted in order and the cursor it left behind.

HostIdentityResolutionV1.description: 🪪️ Resolution of the shell's landing and host app aliases against the installed app list. Exactly one editor app per alias — a missing or ambiguous alias is a refusal, never a fallback.

BootstrapStatusV1.description: 📥️ Every bootstrap status the shell renders. A progress notice is polite status; a failure or rebootstrap demand is an assertive alert.

LocalizedNoticeTextV1.description: 🈯️ Notice copy carried per locale. English and German are both required — the shell has no default language.

ExtensionInvocationCompletionV1.description: ✅️ The single terminal completion an extension invocation publishes: the surface it settled on, the revision it advanced to, and the history patch it left.

ExtensionCompletionRefusalV1.description: ⛔️ A completion the shell refuses to publish, with the exact reason it was refused.

MountedArtifactFrontierV1.description: 🌿 The exact scope-bound checkpoint frontier acknowledged by one mounted browser actor.

AgentBridgeOfferRecordV2.description: One live gateway's offer file, `<rendezvous>/offers/<pid>.json` (`🌉️mcp/🛰️rendezvous::BridgeOffer`): served by the supervisor only to a shell its scope admits.

schema.title: Semio OS Plugin Host Ui Patch

ArtifactToolPublicationLane.$comment: Canonical retained-command publication lanes, one PascalCase member per ArtifactToolPublicationLane runtime variant. Owners narrow this closed vocabulary with const or enum.

InteractiveJobClassification.$comment: Canonical retained-command proof classifications, one PascalCase member per InteractiveJobClassification runtime variant.

RetainedCommandAdmissionOutcome.$comment: Admission outcomes that are decisions rather than InteractiveJobClassification variants.

RetainedCommandCohortFactory.$comment: The one shared command-job factory a cohort of sibling apps publishes through — an object, unlike RetainedCommandDeclaredLimits' single factory string.

RetainedCommandCohortRoute.$comment: A cohort route separates the lanes a route EMITS from the lanes its publication contract declares; the three RetainedCommandRoute dialects collapse both into one `lanes` array.

RetainedCommandCensus.$comment: Census counts a cohort law asserts about itself (apps, routesPerApp, identities, retained, batchOnlyPendingRewrite, …); every owner narrows the members it declares with const.

RetainedCommandRoute.$comment: One route row, published so an owner can narrow a single route positionally without reaching into definitions.

RetainedCommandRoutes.$comment: Shared shape for retained-command route tables, standalone or nested in RetainedCommandLimits.

RetainedCommandCohort.$comment: The cohort law form: one shared factory and route table published by N sibling apps, plus the census that count implies. RetainedCommandDeclaredLimits cannot describe it — its factory is a string and its controller/documentSchema are single-valued, where a cohort carries them per app.

MutationSourceAuthorityProjectionV1.title: Mutation Source Authority Projection
MutationSourceAuthorityProjectionV1.description: The taxonomy facts the mutation derive macros read at compile time, generated from 🔣️taxonomy.json so only a change to these facts invalidates a deriving crate.
